      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime, ForeignKey, REAL, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Aircraft(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"aircraft\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    tail_number = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    model = Column(String)\n    manufacturer = Column(String)\n    passenger_capacity = Column(Integer, CheckConstraint(\"passenger_capacity IS NULL OR passenger_capacity >= 0\"))\n    baggage_capacity_lbs = Column(REAL, CheckConstraint(\"baggage_capacity_lbs IS NULL OR baggage_capacity_lbs >= 0\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Airport(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"airports\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    icao_code = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    iata_code = Column(String, unique=True)\n    name = Column(String)\n    city = Column(String)\n    country = Column(String)\n    latitude = Column(REAL)\n    longitude = Column(REAL)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Flight(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"flights\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    flight_number = Column(String)\n    aircraft_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"aircraft.id\"), nullable=False)\n    origin_airport_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"airports.id\"), nullable=False)\n    destination_airport_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"airports.id\"), nullable=False)\n    departure_datetime_utc = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    arrival_datetime_utc = Column(DateTime)\n    flight_type = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"charter\", CheckConstraint(\"flight_type IN ('charter', 'scheduled', 'private', 'cargo', 'ferry')\"))\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"scheduled\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('scheduled', 'boarding', 'departed', 'en_route', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed')\"))\n    passenger_count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0, CheckConstraint(\"passenger_count >= 0\"))\n    baggage_weight_lbs = Column(REAL, nullable=False, default=0, CheckConstraint(\"baggage_weight_lbs >= 0\"))\n    special_requests = Column(String)\n    created_by_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        CheckConstraint(\"origin_airport_id <> destination_airport_id\"),\n    )"
    }
